options.title: Synthetic decay — help
options.text:
# Synthetic decay editor

Build a fluorescence decay from an amplitude/lifetime spectrum, or load a measured pattern.

## Lifetime spectrum
Each row is one exponential component: **Amplitude** (relative weight) and **Lifetime** (ns). Right-click the spectrum table, or use ➕ / ➖, to add or remove components.

- **📂 Pattern…** — use a measured decay histogram (text / .npy) instead of the spectrum.
- **📥 Fit…** — copy the lifetime spectrum from an open ChiSurf fit.

## IRF
- **Experimental IRF** — load a measured instrument response (overrides the synthetic Gaussian).
- **Gaussian FWHM / Skew** — a synthetic (optionally skewed) Gaussian IRF; skew 0 = symmetric.
- **Colour shift (ns)** — sub-bin periodic time shift of the IRF.

## Convolution
- **Laser period (ns)** — set for periodic convolution (e.g. 12.5 ns at 80 MHz); this adds the inter-pulse tail from earlier pulses. 0 = aperiodic.

## Shot noise
Enable **Poisson noise** to sample a finite-count observation from the given **Photons** and **Seed**; otherwise the ideal pattern is normalized to unit sum.

The preview updates live as you edit.

sections.label: Experimental IRF
sections.description: Load a measured instrument response histogram (text / .npy); overrides the synthetic Gaussian below.

sections.label: Gaussian FWHM (ns)
sections.description: Synthetic Gaussian IRF width; 0 = ideal (no IRF) unless an experimental IRF is loaded.

sections.label: Skew
sections.description: Skewness of the synthetic IRF (0 = symmetric Gaussian); models the asymmetric detector-response tail.

sections.label: Colour shift (ns)
sections.description: Sub-bin periodic time shift of the IRF (TCSPC colour shift); wraps over the window.

sections.label: Laser period (ns)
sections.description: Repetition period for periodic convolution (e.g. 12.5 ns at 80 MHz); adds the inter-pulse tail from earlier pulses. 0 = aperiodic (linear) convolution.

sections.label: Poisson noise
sections.description: Sample a finite-count histogram; off = normalized ideal pattern.

sections.label: Photons
sections.description: Expected integrated photons for Poisson sampling.

sections.label: Seed
sections.description: Reproducible random seed; change for another realization.

sections.title: Decay preview
